_about: How names and recurring terms are written in this language on Deovandski's site, so they are always spelled the same. Names are written by sound, never translated (the author's rule). #HusbandOutWorld names come from HusbandOutWorld's content/i18n/zh/glossary.json, which is the source: the names below are copied from it for the ones this site uses. Correct a series name there and here together, and look up any other series name there. Add this site's own names here the first time you translate them.
rule: Series names follow HusbandOutWorld's rule for this language: Story names in Chinese characters chosen for sound (standard transliteration characters; feminine characters such as 丽/娅/莉 for women). This covers coined world terms too: creatures, plants, items, nari gels, spells, factions, guilds, places, ranks and coins (Wood People = 伍德皮普尔, Sapphire = 萨菲尔, Bleed Out = 布利德奥特). Multi-part personal names join with ·; one-word compound terms are written together. Japanese-origin names (Hiromi, Takeo, Yosuke…) use their usual kanji. Plain words are translated (Soul Tree = 索尔树, Nari Stones = 纳里石). The currency balls is 球 (萨菲尔球, 珀尔球), matching Japanese ボール; the unit timehunk stays in Latin letters. Real people (Deovandski, Mitsukiven, Feiourm), the title and pets named in the afterwords (Peeta, Fluffy, Maddog) stay in Latin letters.
site_rules: Real people and pets stay in Latin letters: Deovandski, Deo, and every family member, friend and pet named on the site (Peeta, Bidu, Fluffy).
Brand, company and product names stay as they are (Wizard Deo Solutions, Microsoft, Dynamics 365 F&O, GitHub, LinkedIn).

Titles in the top-39 lists (games, anime, TV, movies), concerts and theater (Deo's answer on #87): use the official title in this language. Movies and TV shows use their official local title; if none exists, keep the English one. Anime keeps the 'Romaji (local title)' structure; in Japanese, show the official Japanese title.
Anything marked translate="no" (Vraki-typeface text, names in a logo, code) stays as it is.
Every tab is translated, Lust, Tattoo and Mentor included (Deo's answer on #87).
